esm.install: esm @ git+https://github.com/Biohub/esm.git@43ccece2ad485f27db46afdb67da2a9601e8f106 (install the transformers pin first, then esm with --no-deps: esm's pyproject declares transformers @ main, floating)
esm.accel_extra: optional-dependencies accel = flash-attn==2.7.4.post1, transformer-engine[pytorch]==2.15.0, nvidia-cublas>=13.6 (pyproject.toml @ the commit)

transformers.origin: the Biohub fork of transformers; the Biohub/transformers repository is no longer public, and github.com/huggingface/transformers serves the same commit unchanged

archive_recipe: git archive --format=tar --prefix=<name>-<commit8>/ <commit> <paths> | gzip -n -9  (esm: esm pyproject.toml LICENSE.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICE.md README.md; transformers: src/transformers setup.py pyproject.toml LICENSE README.md)

accel.role: pinned stack (the one stack of this kit: every mode runs on it)
accel.tested_on: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (sm90), torch 2.11.0+cu130 / CUDA 13.0 / cuDNN 9.19.0, flash-attn 2.7.4.post1, transformer-engine 2.15.0 (a documentation line: nothing compares against it)
accel.definition: upstream's install line resolved on Python 3.12 (torch 2.11.0+cu130), xformers removed, plus upstream's own `accel` extra (flash-attn 2.7.4.post1, transformer-engine 2.15.0 with its cu13 and torch pieces, nvidia-cublas >= 13.6); route B runs bf16 + flash_attention_2 on a Transformer-Engine-backed encoder

weights.root: the HF cache under HF_HOME (upstream's own location: hub/models--biohub--ESMC-<SIZE>/snapshots/<commit>)

weights_layout.root: the HF cache under HF_HOME (upstream's own location: hub/models--biohub--ESMC-<SIZE>/snapshots/<commit>)
weights_layout.hf_home: the directory HF_HOME names (README 'Variables'): the checkpoints resolve under <HF_HOME>/hub/models--<org>--<repo>/snapshots/<commit>/
weights_layout.form: HF cache: hf/hub/models--<org>--<repo>/snapshots/<commit>/ with refs/main = the commit; read with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
weights_layout.manifest: python -I stock/check_pins.py --weights <root> --variant <v> checks every pinned file under <root>/hf/hub/ against the digests above (HF_HOME = <root>/hf)

entry_point.route_B: client = esm.models.esmc.ESMC.from_pretrained(<model name>, device=<device>) [esm/models/esmc/compatibility.py:154-168: bf16 off CPU, attn_implementation flash_attention_2 (use_flash_attn=True default) else sdpa]; protein_tensor = client.encode(ESMProtein(sequence=seq)); out = client.logits(protein_tensor, LogitsConfig(sequence=True, return_embeddings=True)) [:296-322: torch.no_grad + autocast(bfloat16), output_hidden_states=True] -> out.logits.sequence [1, L+2, 64], out.embeddings [1, L+2, d]; client.model = the package's EsmcForMaskedLM (where the levers attach)
entry_point.route_B_raw_batched: tokenizer(sequences, return_tensors='pt', padding=True); model(input_ids=…, attention_mask=…, output_hidden_states=True) under torch.inference_mode() [cookbook/snippets/esmc.py raw_forward] — the user's own padded batched form (the batched regime, --batch N)
entry_point.route_A: transformers fork: AutoModelForMaskedLM.from_pretrained(<repo>, device_map='auto') + AutoTokenizer; model(**inputs) under torch.inference_mode(); fp32 checkpoint dtype [upstream README] — documented, not an arm of this tree
entry_point.route: route_B (this tree's stock arm and every lever)
entry_point.one_prediction: one sequence through the one-protein call of route B (batch 1); batched and unbatched outputs are not bitwise-comparable by construction (padding changes the reduction composition)
entry_point.script: none: the kit ships no caller of its own — the user's own code makes the route B calls (README 'Run'); the kit engages inside ESMC.from_pretrained when ESMC_OPT=exact

route_B.dtype: bfloat16 when the device is not CPU; logits() runs under torch.autocast(bfloat16)
route_B.attention: flash_attention_2 when flash_attn imports, else the package's F.scaled_dot_product_attention path
route_B.encoder: Transformer Engine modules when transformer_engine imports on CUDA (esm/models/esmc/model.py: use_te = on_cuda and TE_INSTALLED), else torch modules

library_defaults.precision: the package sets no numerics flag (PyTorch defaults)

stock_environment.home: opt/esmc_opt/registry.py KIT_SWITCHES (the kits' switches, file:line each) + stack.PACKAGE_ENV (the package's own) + stack.PACKAGE_COMPOSED_ENV; must_be_absent below is locked to that union by the package's tests

licence.weights: the model cards' licence field: mit (+ the third-party notices)
